svg.metadata: Ferrosift investor review v01; model-derived HLR and solid sections; geometry mm; A3 landscape; Actual solid sections / sensing interfaces
svg.text: A-A at x=1600 / B-B at y=0 / tinted regions are exact intersections with exported solids
A-A / transverse plane x1600 / exact solid cut / 1:10
B-B / longitudinal centre plane y0 / exact solid cut / 1:10
Actual solid intersections expose the belt, support window, cassette shell and mounting interfaces at these
planes. The optional depth envelope is unbuilt. A hollow enclosure is not a coil design or validated sensor
No steel slider bed is proposed in the reserved sensing region. Nearby steel, wiring, belt constituents and return
geometry still require electromagnetic baseline and interference tests.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE: PER VIEW AT A3 | DO NOT SCALE FOR MANUFACTURE
Preliminary study geometry. Proposed inspection targets on sheet 8 are unapproved; no load, sensing or safety rating.
